description: Hash and verify passwords with bcrypt. Operations: "hash" — Hash a password with bcrypt at the given cost.; "verify" — Verify a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: hash returns a different result on each call.

input.description: hash: The plaintext password to hash. verify: The plaintext password to check.

operation.description: hash — Hash a password with bcrypt at the given cost. verify — Verify a plaintext password against a bcrypt hash.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

hash.description: The bcrypt hash to compare against (cost 4 or lower over the API). Used by: verify. Required by: verify.

rounds.description: Cost factor (log2 of the rounds). The API runs cost 4 to 4; higher costs run in the browser at /tools/bcrypt. Used by: hash.

name: bcrypt
title: Bcrypt Generator & Verifier
